dataforseo.implemented_scope: Google Organic Live Advanced parser and approval-gated live adapter
dataforseo.limitation: Live DataForSEO calls require --network-approved, --paid-approved, credentials, query count, requested top URL count (`--depth`, not pagination pages), GEO/language approval, and explicit --load-async-ai-overview when that paid option is needed.

permission_boundary: Live provider calls require explicit --network-approved and provider credentials. Secrets are masked and not written to reports.
